column3: MT 51:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “compassions” “tender mercies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wash me much” is rendered “Wash me thoroughly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I know my transgressions” is rendered “I acknowledge my transgressions.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “be found,” and תִּזְכֶּה (“be clear”) is rendered “blameless.”
Close to the Hebrew; בַטֻּחוֹת (“in the inward parts”) is rendered “in the inward parts,” and “faithfulness” “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future “you will cleanse me” is rendered as a request, “Purge me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the spirit of your holiness” is capitalized “Your Holy Spirit.”
NKJV renders “a willing spirit” as “Your generous Spirit,” capitalized and taken as God’s Spirit.
Close to the Hebrew; יָשׁוּבוּ (“will return”) is rendered “shall be converted.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִדָּמִים (“from bloodshed”) is rendered “from the guilt of bloodshed.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְנִדְכֶּה (“crushed”) is rendered “contrite,” and NKJV supplies “These.”
